verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk-operation feature. RudderStack does offer APIs to programmatically manage connections, transformations and libraries, and an MCP server whose natural-language queries span sources (e.g. finding duplicate event names across sources), so a user could script or agent-drive multi-item changes. That is only implied, not a first-class bulk capability. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete endpoints or MCP tools, a documented batch workflow for managing many sources, destinations or transformations at once, any OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and hands-on corroboration.
